title: Zoho Books Credit Notes: Refund or Apply to an Invoice #Shorts
description:
A customer returned goods or you overbilled? In Zoho Books create a credit note under Sales > Credit Notes. Then either apply it to an open invoice (open the credit note, click Apply to Invoice, enter the amount under Credits to Apply, Save) or refund it (select the credit note, More > Refund, enter the amount, Save). A partly used credit note stays Open; once fully used it becomes Closed.

Sources (checked 18 Nov 2026):
- Zoho Books help - Apply Credits to Invoices: https://www.zoho.com/us/books/help/credit-note/apply-credits.html
- Zoho Books help - Refund Credits: https://www.zoho.com/us/books/help/credit-note/refund-credits.html
- Zoho Books FAQ - refund for returned goods: https://www.zoho.com/us/books/kb/credits/issue-refund.html

This video uses an AI-generated presenter (based on the creator), voice and animations; facts were checked against the sources above.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation.
